adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, permission logic computes `isTeamAdminOrOwner` as `(await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0))`. For non-team bookings where `booking.eventType?.teamId` is `undefined`, this will always check team id `0`, which effectively makes the “team admin/owner” branch irrelevant for personal bookings and may trigger unnecessary DB checks (and depends on how `isTeamAdmin/isTeamOwner` handle `0`). The diff doesn’t prove it causes incorrect authorization, since organizers/attendees are still allowed via the other checks, but it is a concrete, diff-grounded logic/clarity concern.
